A GUIDE TO THE SCORES

Three different questions.

01 / BQS

How good is the business?

Business quality weighs the operating franchise, governance, capital allocation, cash generation and balance-sheet resilience.

67 ranking-eligible scores
02 / GQS

How good is the growth?

Growth quality considers durability, execution and whether expansion can produce dependable per-share economic value.

69 ranking-eligible scores
03 / IAS

Does the entry price work?

Entry attractiveness is conditional on valuation, funding, downside and implementation assumptions in each company analysis.

25 ranking-eligible scores
Score definitions & research boundaries

Factor scores use a 1–10 scale. NS means required evidence or model support is insufficient; it is not a zero or a negative conclusion. Ranges are mathematical bounds, not point estimates. Provisional scores and gate-excluded assessments remain unranked. ETF reviews use a separate rubric.

Ranks reflect the current filters, with ties for equal displayed scores. Price dates are company-specific. The research is dated 5 October 2026 and is not a live price feed. Scenarios are analytical assumptions, not forecasts or promised returns. Read the funding conditions, risks and original sources in the company analysis before drawing an investment conclusion.

This material is research, not personalized investment advice. Research coverage does not establish investor suitability or that a company qualifies for investment.
